First, note the given date is 03-19-1345 (MM-DD-YYYY).  
Subtract 102 days:  

1345 is not a leap year (divisible by 100 but not by 400).  
March has 31 days, so:  
From March 19, go back 19 days → March 0 = February 28 (since 1345 Feb has 28 days).  
102 total days: 19 days to reach Feb 28 leaves 83 days left.  

February 28 back 28 days → January 31.  
83 - 28 = 55 days left.  
January 31 back 31 days → December 31, 1344.  
55 - 31 = 24 days left.  
December 31 back 24 days → December 7, 1344.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1344-12-07
